title: A foundation model for generalizable cancer diagnosis and survival prediction from histopathological images

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Computational pathology, utilizing whole slide images (WSIs) for pathological diagnosis, has advanced the development of intelligent healthcare.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《A foundation model for generalizable cancer diagnosis and survival prediction from histopathological images》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】Here we show BEPH (BEiT-based model Pre-training on Histopathological image), a foundation model that leverages self-supervised learning to learn meaningful representations from 11 million unlabeled histopathological images.

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】By leveraging the masked image modeling (MIM) pre-training approach, BEPH offers an efficient solution to enhance model performance, reduce the reliance on expert annotations, and facilitate the broader application of artificial intelligence in clinical settings.

evidence.text: Here we show BEPH (BEiT-based model Pre-training on Histopathological image), a foundation model that leverages self-supervised learning to learn meaningful representations from 11 million unlabeled histopathological images.

By leveraging the masked image modeling (MIM) pre-training approach, BEPH offers an efficient solution to enhance model performance, reduce the reliance on expert annotations, and facilitate the broader application of artificial intelligence in clinical settings.
